name: scroll-map
title: Scroll Map
description: A map beside the text that draws a route as you scroll: the line is drawn, a dot rides its end and the camera follows it, zooming in and back out; a button opens the map to full width.
author: Tom Miller <https://codepen.io/creativeocean>
docs:
Installed `ScrollMap` (with its generated street map, Motion engine and styles) in `components/ui/`, plus the `use-reduced-motion` hook in `hooks/` and `composeRefs` in `lib/`. ```tsx import { ScrollMap } from "@/components/ui/scroll-map";

Bike to Work Day

Meet at the garden at nine.

 ``` The map is pinned to the left half while the text scrolls on the right; the route is drawn as you scroll, the dot rides its end and the camera follows it, zooming in and back out. Give it a route (`route`, an SVG path in a 1500 x 1500 space) and the picture under it (`art`; the default is a generated street map, replace it with your own SVG or an ``). To scroll a box instead of the page, pass its ref as `container` (the box needs `position: relative`, a fixed height and `container-type: size`). Needs `motion` (installed). Under reduced motion the whole route is drawn and nothing is scrubbed. Ported from Tom Miller's pen (MIT, copyright 2026 by Tom Miller); the pen's GSAP, map photograph and web font are not part of it. The license text is in each file.
